title: Solvent-mediated organocatalytic browning of biogenic indoles enables the formation of zwitterionic nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13114-13123
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09863G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Teh-Min Hu, Hsin-Hui Lin, Chun-Yi Huang, Mei-Hsiang Lin, Shih-Jiuan Chiu
Biogenic indoles cooperatively undergo solvent-mediated browning to yield zwitterionic nanoparticles. Intermolecular organocatalysis enables controllable nanostructure formation and electrostatic interaction with nucleic acids.
